narration: Pooja's total is short by more than twelve thousand rupees. Nothing on screen says so.
caption: पूजा का कुल जोड़ 12,000 रुपये से ज़्यादा कम है, स्क्रीन पर कोई चेतावनी नहीं
image_brief: A paper ledger page open on a wooden desk, a long column of handwritten amounts ending in a total line circled twice in red pencil, warm lamp light falling from the left.

narration: She adds the same column again on a calculator. Fifty-three thousand five hundred, every single time.
caption: कैलकुलेटर पर वही कॉलम फिर जोड़ा तो हर बार 53,500 ही आया
image_brief: A desk calculator with a printed paper tape curling off the table edge onto the floor, the tape covered in a column of figures, bright morning window light.

narration: The spreadsheet insists on forty-one thousand. Same twelve rows. Same column, same file, same afternoon.
caption: शीट कहती है 41,000 — वही बारह पंक्तियाँ, वही कॉलम, वही फ़ाइल
image_brief: Two printed sheets lying side by side on a table, each one ending in a different total, one of the two figures boxed in blue ink, flat overhead daylight.

narration: No error message appears. No red cell, no scolding dialogue. Nothing looks broken.
caption: कोई एरर नहीं, कोई लाल सेल नहीं, कुछ भी टूटा हुआ नहीं दिखता
image_brief: Twelve small white cards pegged along a taut string line across a room, each card showing an amount in neat print, no marks or flags anywhere on them, soft even light.

narration: Every amount sits there in plain sight. Each one looks exactly like a number.
caption: हर रकम साफ़ दिख रही है और बिल्कुल नंबर जैसी लगती है
image_brief: A shallow tray of brass tokens stamped with numbers, all of them polished to the same shine and arranged in rows, bright tabletop light from above.

narration: Nine of the twelve really are numbers. Three of them only look like it.
caption: बारह में से नौ सच में नंबर हैं, तीन बस नंबर जैसे दिखते हैं
image_brief: The same tray of brass tokens, but three tokens are revealed as painted wooden copies, lighter in colour with visible grain, low side light raking across them.

narration: And one whole column must never be converted. Hold on to that one.
caption: और एक पूरे कॉलम को कभी बदलना नहीं चाहिए — यह बात याद रखें
image_brief: A narrow rack of wooden tokens standing apart from the brass trays, a small padlock closed across the rack's lid, low warm light pooling around it.

narration: SUM has exactly one rule. It adds numbers, and it steps over everything else.
caption: SUM का एक ही नियम है: नंबर जोड़ता है, बाक़ी सब छोड़ देता है
image_brief: A metal sorting chute above two bins, coins dropping cleanly into the near bin while flat paper squares slide past into a side tray, cool workshop light.

narration: Text inside the range is not an error to SUM. It is furniture, quietly ignored.
caption: रेंज में टेक्स्ट SUM के लिए एरर नहीं, बस फ़र्नीचर है जिसे वह छोड़ देता है
image_brief: A wooden crate of numbered blocks with a folded paper napkin wedged upright between two of them, the crate's counting lever passing straight over the napkin, dusty attic light.

narration: So the real question gets narrower. Why would a digit not be a number?
caption: तो असली सवाल और छोटा हो जाता है: एक अंक नंबर क्यों नहीं होता?
image_brief: A magnifying glass lying flat on a printed figure so the digits underneath swell and blur at the edges, daylight coming through a nearby window.

narration: Every cell stores two separate things. A value, and the kind of thing that value is.
caption: हर सेल दो अलग चीज़ें रखता है — वैल्यू, और वह किस तरह की चीज़ है
image_brief: A cardboard box on a shelf with two labels stapled to its side, the upper label listing the contents and the lower label naming the kind of contents, plain shelf light.

narration: Type four thousand two hundred yourself. Excel files it away as a quantity.
caption: आप ख़ुद 4200 टाइप करें तो एक्सेल उसे मात्रा की तरह रखता है
image_brief: The figure 4200 pressed deep into a slab of wet clay on a workbench, the impression solid and shadowed, a shaped stylus resting alongside, workbench lamp light.

narration: Paste the same digits out of a download. Excel may file them as a label.
caption: वही अंक किसी डाउनलोड से पेस्ट करें तो एक्सेल उन्हें लेबल बना सकता है
image_brief: A thin paper sticker printed 4200 peeling away at one corner from a smooth grey metal plate, cold storeroom light from a high window.

narration: The label reads 4200 on screen. It can be shown, sorted, printed. Never added.
caption: लेबल स्क्रीन पर 4200 दिखाता है — दिख सकता है, जुड़ नहीं सकता
image_brief: A shop price tag hanging from a string above a brass balance pan, the tag resting on the pan without tipping it at all, showroom light.

narration: Where does a label like that come from? Almost always from somewhere outside your file.
caption: ऐसा लेबल कहाँ से आता है? लगभग हमेशा आपकी फ़ाइल के बाहर से
image_brief: A cardboard carton standing on a doorstep with a courier label and a foreign postmark across it, early morning light stretching a long shadow across the tiles.
